verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented local REST API (OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, 22 paths, generated developer reference) plus an official MCP server package that fronts it, and a CLI/headless server mode for automation — all confirmed by both docs and runtime probes. missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials building against the API beyond the vendor's own probes, and no public hosted/remote API (localhost-only).
